description: Displayed at Salaria Square in front of Sudan Block (NDA main building); appears upgraded to Ajeet standard but plaque calls it a Gnat (warbirds.in; Bharat Rakshak E-247).
Unmarked MiG-21bis on the NDA parade ground, identified as C2134 (Atamvir Singh Multani 2011 via warbirds.in; Bharat Rakshak C-2134).
Two-seat MiG-21U noted on Google Earth imagery to the rear (north-west) of Sudan Block, number U663 per warbirds.in (their table also prints U633 - unverified).
Indian Navy Sea Hawk displayed wings folded on the NDA parade ground, no markings; identity IN233 per Atamvir Singh Multani 2011 (warbirds.in).
Mystere IVA IA1022 (c/n 347) displayed near the Cadets' Mess (warbirds.in; Bharat Rakshak IA-1022).

Ouragan IC585 (c/n 279) in No.4 Sqn Oorials markings coded R, with tip tanks, moved from the Cadets' Mess to the NDA gliderdrome/airstrip; excellent condition (warbirds.in, Kapil Chandni; Bharat Rakshak IC-585).

Flown Bareilly-Pune by Wg Cdr A Chauhan after the 1 May 2006 MiG-25 phase-out, trucked to NDA 15 Nov 2006 and installed on a platform at Gol Market inside the campus with a plaque; Kargil and Op Parakram veteran (warbirds.in, Manu Pubby; Bharat Rakshak KP-351).
Canberra B(I)58 IF906 (c/n 71493, ex RAF WT338; 35 Sqn 1965, 106 Sqn 2004) listed at NDA Khadakvasla by warbirds.in table and Bharat Rakshak; exact spot on campus not documented.
MiG-27ML TS564 listed by the Bharat Rakshak database as preserved at an NDA traffic circle, Khadakvasla. Single-source; not on warbirds.in NDA page; needs confirmation.
